question: The secretariat of Association of Southeast Asian Nations was set up in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)** was founded on **August 8, 1967**, with five founding members: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.
 
• In **1976**, the ASEAN Secretariat was established in **Jakarta, Indonesia**, to coordinate and facilitate ASEAN’s activities and ensure efficient implementation of its policies.
 
• The Secretariat plays a crucial role in promoting cooperation among member states in areas such as **economic growth, cultural development, and regional stability**.
 
• The establishment of the Secretariat marked a significant milestone in ASEAN’s institutional development, enhancing its organizational structure and operational efficiency.
 
• The first Secretary-General of ASEAN was Hartono
